blockHeight.label: Block Height
blockHeight.description: The number of blocks produced since genesis. It grows by one with every new block.

totalTransactions.label: Transactions
totalTransactions.description: Total transactions processed by the network since genesis.

txPerBlock.label: Tx per Block
txPerBlock.description: Average number of transactions included per block, measured over the latest 100 blocks.

blockTime.label: Block Time
blockTime.description: Average time between consecutive blocks, measured over the latest 100 blocks.

inflation.label: Inflation
inflation.description: The yearly rate at which new tokens are minted to reward stakers and fund the community pool.

stakingApr.label: Staking APR
stakingApr.description: Estimated yearly return on staked tokens, before validator commission.
stakingApr.formula: APR = inflation × (1 − community tax) ÷ bonded ratio

bondedTokens.label: Bonded Tokens
bondedTokens.description: Tokens currently staked with active validators. Bonded stake is what secures the network.

totalSupply.label: Total Supply
totalSupply.description: Every token in existence, including those that are staked. It grows with inflation.

communityPool.label: Community Pool
communityPool.description: Tokens controlled by on-chain governance. A share of inflation flows in; successful proposals spend it.
communityPool.formula: pool grows by supply × inflation × community tax

poolValue.label: Pool Value
poolValue.description: Estimated US-dollar value of the community pool at the simulated token price.
